sovereignAI.sup: If you are new to the term
sovereignAI.headline: What is sovereign AI
sovereignAI.p1Before: Sovereign AI is AI that runs
sovereignAI.p1After: , under the institution's own governance, not in a vendor's cloud.
sovereignAI.p2: Most platforms calling themselves "sovereign AI" today are hosted services with European billing addresses. The data still crosses the vendor's network, the inference still runs on the vendor's hardware, and the audit trail still belongs to the vendor. That is regulatory residency, not operational sovereignty.
sovereignAI.p3: Davion is operationally sovereign: deployments run inside the customer's perimeter, air-gapped, on-prem, or in a sovereign cloud bound by contract. The data does not leave. The weights are auditable on-prem. Every decision traces back to the source it was made on.

why.p1: The category has confused regulatory residency with operational sovereignty.
why.p2: Most platforms calling themselves "sovereign AI" today are hosted services with European billing addresses. The data crosses the vendor's network. The inference runs on the vendor's hardware. The audit trail lives in the vendor's cloud. The contract says "sovereign" because the postcode is European.
why.p3: For banks, ministries, and operators of critical infrastructure, that is not sovereignty. It is procurement theatre. The data is still leaving. The decisions are still being made somewhere the operator doesn't control. The audit trail still belongs to the vendor.
why.p4Before: Davion exists because the gap between
why.p4After: is the gap between a platform a defense ministry can use and a platform it cannot. We build for the second.
why.p5: Our deployments run inside the customer's perimeter. The data does not leave. The weights are auditable on-prem. The inference runs where the work runs, air-gapped, on-prem, or in a sovereign cloud bound by contract. Every decision is traceable to the data it was made on, the policy it applied, and the version of the model that produced it.
why.p6: This is not marketing copy. It is the operational difference between a platform that can be used and one that cannot.

believe.headline: Five claims we will defend in public
believe.body: Every product decision Davion makes traces back to one of these. If you read them and disagree, we're probably not the right vendor, and that's a useful thing to learn early.
believe.c01t: Sovereignty is where the work happens
believe.c01b: Regulatory residency is not sovereignty. Hosted AI with a European postcode is not sovereignty. Sovereignty is determined by where the data lives, where the weights are stored, and where the inference runs. Davion runs where the work runs.
believe.c02t: A decision is only defensible when it can be reconstructed
believe.c02b: AI without an audit trail is not AI an institution can use. Every output Davion produces points back to the data it was made on, the policy it applied, and the version of the model that produced it. If a regulator asks "why", the platform has an answer.
believe.c03t: The hard cases are not edge cases
believe.c03b: Air-gapped. On-prem. Inside a perimeter you control. These are not exceptions to the category, they are the operational reality of every institution where decisions actually matter. We design for the hard case first; the easier deployments are downstream.
believe.c04b: Davion is composable end to end and replaceable end to end. Ingestion, ontology, analytics, agentic layer, action, each is replaceable. We intend to be a vendor you can leave. That is how vendors who deserve to stay get to stay.
believe.c05t: The operator runs the system. We do not run the decisions.
believe.c05b: Davion is a platform, not an autonomous agent. The decisions belong to the people accountable for them: the analyst, the compliance officer, the operator, the commander. The platform proposes, cites its sources, and waits for approval. We do not move money. We do not move people. We do not move troops.

work.p1bold: Engagements begin with a briefing, not a pitch.
work.p1: We listen first, to your data architecture, your regulatory constraints, your operational reality, the decisions you actually need to defend. The first conversation is consultative; if Davion isn't the right answer, we will say so.
work.p2: Most engagements start with a 6 to 12 week pilot scoped against a specific, measurable outcome, typically a single decision class (e.g. AML alert triage, anomaly detection on operational telemetry, OSINT brief generation). The deliverable is a working deployment inside your perimeter, plus the operational evidence to decide whether to expand.
work.p3Before: On-prem, air-gapped, or sovereign cloud, your choice. Davion's job is to make all three operationally identical from the surface. The deployment matrix lives on
work.p4bold: We intend to be a vendor you can leave.
work.p4: Davion is modular end to end. Ingestion, ontology, analytics, agentic layer, action, each is a replaceable component. The data, the weights, and the audit log are yours from day one. That is how vendors who deserve to stay get to stay.
